rows.question: Find institutions from the region of Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_base AS (
  SELECT
    i.unics_id AS unics_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.institutions_name), '') AS institutions_name,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.acronym), '') AS acronym,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.short_name), '') AS short_name,
    i.country_id AS country_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.geocode_regions_3), '') AS geocode_regions_3,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.website), '') AS website,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.db_pedia_url), '') AS db_pedia_url,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.wikidata_url), '') AS wikidata_url,
    NULLIF(btrim(i.grid_id), '') AS grid_id
  FROM institutions i
)
SELECT
  unics_id,
  institutions_name,
  acronym,
  short_name,
  country_id,
  geocode_regions_3,
  website,
  db_pedia_url,
  wikidata_url,
  grid_id
FROM institutions_base
WHERE geocode_regions_3 ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
   OR geocode_regions_3 ILIKE '%North Jutland%'
   OR short_name ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
   OR institutions_name ILIKE '%Nordjylland%'
ORDER BY institutions_name ASC

rows.question: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
rows.pred_sql:
WITH institutions_base AS (
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  -- canonicalize institution name: NULL if empty after trim, else trimmed
  NULLIF(btrim(i.institutions_name), '') AS institutions_name,
  -- acronym and short_name normalized similarly
  NULLIF(btrim(i.acronym), '') AS acronym,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.short_name), '') AS short_name,
  -- carry through country_id and geocode regions
  i.country_id AS country_id,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.geocode_regions_3), '') AS geocode_regions_3,
  -- websites and external identifiers normalized (trimmed, empty -> NULL)
  NULLIF(btrim(i.website), '') AS website,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.db_pedia_url), '') AS db_pedia_url,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.wikidata_url), '') AS wikidata_url,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.grid_id), '') AS grid_id
FROM
  institutions i
),
eu_territorial_units_lookup AS (
SELECT
  etu.description,
  etu.geocode_regions,
  etu.geocode_level,
  etu.nuts_version
FROM
  eu_territorial_units etu
WHERE
  etu.geocode_level = (
    -- lift the desired smallest geocode level out as a literal:
    3
  )
ORDER BY
  etu.description NULLS LAST,
  etu.geocode_regions
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.institutions_name
FROM institutions_base b
JOIN eu_territorial_units_lookup u
  ON b.geocode_regions_3 = u.geocode_regions
WHERE u.description = 'Nordjylland'
ORDER BY b.institutions_name

rows.question: Find the name of principal investigators in projects that started in 2014
rows.pred_sql:

  p.unics_id,

FROM
  people p
),
projects_core_9 AS (
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  -- canonical integer year columns: prefer explicit start_year/end_year if present,
  -- otherwise derive from dates (extract year). Lift literals: none.
  COALESCE(p.start_year, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer END) AS start_year,
  COALESCE(p.end_year,   CASE WHEN p.end_date   IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer   END) AS end_year,
  p.ec_call,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  p.principal_investigator,
  p.acronym
FROM projects p
),
projects_core AS (
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  p.total_cost AS total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution AS ec_max_contribution,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,

  p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,

project_with_programmes_and_subjects AS (

  p.unics_id AS project,
  pp.programme AS programme,
  psa.subject_area AS subject_area,
  pt.topic AS topic,
  pep.panel AS panel
FROM projects_core p
-- Left join to project_programmes: a project may have zero or more programmes

-- Left join to project_subject_areas: a project may have zero or more subject areas

projects_title_lookup_norm AS (

  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  -- Lifted literals: trimming whitespace and normalizing internal whitespace to single spaces,
  -- then lower-casing for case-insensitive matching.
  -- Uses regexp_replace to collapse any sequence of whitespace into a single space.

  projects_core p

rows.question: Find the projects which lasted the longest and have an end year and a start year
rows.pred_sql:
WITH projects_core AS (
  SELECT
    p.unics_id,
    p.acronym,
    p.title,
    p.start_year,
    p.end_year
  FROM projects p
),
projects_duration_years AS (
  SELECT
    pc.unics_id,
    pc.acronym,
    pc.title,
    pc.start_year,
    pc.end_year,
    (pc.end_year - pc.start_year) AS duration_years
  FROM projects_core pc
  WHERE pc.start_year IS NOT NULL
    AND pc.end_year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.duration_years
FROM projects_duration_years p
WHERE p.duration_years = (
  SELECT MAX(duration_years) FROM projects_duration_years
)
